title: RPG Maker 2000 - Play animations on a skill that effects the party?

posts.author: beetlesheII
posts.body:
I found that battle animations just dont play when a skill effects the user or a fellow party member, only enemies, which is pretty annoying.
I found a way to do it by messing around with switches battle pages, but its pretty annoying since i have to fiddle around with a lot and it doesnt work the same way as skills normally do. Is there a better way to do this that works more naturally with both the overworld and in battle? I want it to look something like this:
